caption: The drawing shows a central geometric shape resembling a blue hexagon with a yellow border, placed horizontally across the center of the composition. Around the blue shape is a green-bordered, oval-shaped frame with purple segments divided by yellow lines. Surrounding the central forms are five radiating, fan-like elements that alternate with three circular objects. The fans are colored in combinations of black, blue, red, pink, and orange with decorative patterns and blue, fluffy textures at their ends. The circular objects feature a layered color scheme: the topmost has a white center surrounded by red, green, and blue rings with jagged blue edges; the bottommost has a white center surrounded by a green ring, a red ring, and a black, spiked outline; the rightmost circular object is orange-red with three black circles and a black-and-blue fluffy base. The entire composition is set on a brown, quilted background that fills the rectangular border of the drawing. The artist's name, "Ruth M. Barnes," is written in cursive at the lower right corner, and a code "L 1763-13" appears at the lower left.
title: Coverlet (Applique Quilt)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
